text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her Make Debut race is finally here. 
Inspired by the previous generation's 
Derby, Meisho Doto is full of motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Driven by the desperate thought that she 
couldn't stay as she was, she approached 
the race in an unusually hyper state.
